hint: Drag blocks and ports. Ctrl + drag a wire to branch. Esc cancels.
recovery_available: A recovery copy is available. Recover opens it as an unsaved circuit.
place_hint: Click to place; Space rotates; Ctrl+M mirrors; Esc cancels.
name: Name
scope_title: Waveforms · Left: cursor A, right: cursor B, wheel: zoom
scope_empty: Select channels and run the simulation
wire_hint: Drag to a port or wire. Release on empty canvas to extend. Esc cancels.
recovered: Recovery copy restored. Save the circuit to a file of your choice.
error_hint: An error occurred. Select a diagnostic message to locate its element.
stopping: Stopping after the current time step…
events_format: Enter time in seconds and state 0 or 1 in the table, e.g. 1e-3 and 1.
bends_format: Enter one x y coordinate pair per line.
positive_time: Duration and time step must be positive.
scope_disabled:
Oscilloscope is off
No sample history is collected. Enable recording and choose channels before starting.
diagnostics_hint: Circuit validation and simulation messages appear here.
junction_hint: Click to place a junction, or start a connection directly from a terminal.
record_next_run: The selected channel will be recorded on the next run.
plot_navigation: Click the active zoom icon again to pan with the left button. Wheel: XY; Ctrl: X; Shift: Y. Middle button always pans.
plot_connect_hint: Connect probe outputs or gate signals to this plot, then press Start.
inspector_empty: Select an element or wire to edit its properties.
empty_steps: Double-click to find a block. Drag ports to connect.
result_outdated: Model changed — run again to update results
gate_replace_text: This switch already has scheduled events or a connected control source. Replace them with the new connection? Undo will restore the previous control settings.
gate_connected_source: Controlled by: %1. Edit switching parameters in the connected source.
component_bar_hint: Click to place a component. Right-click a library component to pin it here.
junction_pass: Pass-through node. Delete joins both wires without breaking the circuit.
zoom_axis: Zoom %1: drag to select a range. Click again to turn Zoom off and pan with the left button.
cursor_place_hint: Choose A or B, a signal and a point on the plot.
cursor_frequency_hint: 1/|Δt| is the reciprocal cursor interval. It is the signal frequency only when the interval spans one complete cycle.
wheel_conflict: X and Y require different modifiers.
label_hint: Label: drag to move, Space to rotate; double-click to edit.
measure_hint: Sample statistics. Analog edges are interpolated between recorded samples.
time_span_hint: Sliding time window, e.g. 100 ms or 0.1 s. 0 shows all data. Editing enables follow; panning and zoom pause it.
channel_source_hint: Select the name to highlight its source in purple on the schematic. The checkbox controls recording separately.
hide_signal: %1 — click to hide this trace. Recording and export are preserved.
all_signals_hidden: All traces are hidden. Click a signal name with an eye icon above the plot.
measurement_peak_bounds: Excursion and distance must be non-negative
measurement_reference_bounds: Low < high; 0 <= lower reference < upper reference <= 100
measurement_axis_bounds: X min >= 0; min < max; span >= 0; 0 < line width <= 10
trigger_bounds: Holdoff >= 0; position must be between 0 and 100%.
curve_rename_hint: Double-click the name to rename. Enter saves, Esc cancels. An empty name restores the original.
curve_style_error: Width: greater than 0 and up to 10 px. Marker: 1–24 px.
definition_readonly: Read only — choose Edit shared definition to make changes
definition_shared: Shared definition: edits affect linked instances
editing_shared_definition: Editing a shared definition. To change just one instance, use Make local copy on its parent level first.
samples_format: Enter time and value on each row, for example: 1ms 5V
import_samples_hint: Load two columns: time and value. Review the table and click Apply.
